subject: cop: ignore locks with the same start_ts (#52461)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent. Change 1: `pkg/store/copr/coprocessor.go` pre-populates `copIterator.resolvedLocks` with `req.StartTs` for non-staleness requests so coprocessor RPCs carry `kvrpcpb.Context.ResolvedLocks` and won’t self-block on locks from the same txn start_ts (pipelined DML case). Verified `txnsnapshot.ClientHelper.SendReqCtx` injects `ResolvedLocks`/`CommittedLocks` into the RPC context. Change 2: `pkg/store/mockstore/unistore/cophandler/closure_exec.go` fixes unistore lock filtering to check `lock.StartTS` (not request `startTS`) against `resolvedLocks`, aligning with the resolved-locks contract and avoiding “ignore all locks” behavior once `StartTs` is inserted. No plausible remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, consistency, or concurrency; upstream/master still contains the same logic (no later fix/revert indicating latent severity).
